title: NBA: 76ers' Ariel Hukporti suffers season-ending Achilles injury

blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — Philadelphia 76ers center Ariel Hukporti suffered a season-ending right Achilles tendon tear in Monday night’s preseason game against the New York Knicks, the team said Tuesday. Hukporti, who signed a free agent deal with Philadelphia in July, suffered the injury in the first quarter. He went down grabbing at his right leg after the non-contact injury before leaving the game. The team said Hukporti will undergo surgery later Tuesday.
